caveat: Screening output. Each flagged patch is a suspected land-cover change from satellite classification, and the options are matched from a curated case bank by fixed rules. Save Vietnam's Wildlife reviews every brief before it is used.

sites.summary: Tam Diep has 42 suspected quarry patches, 154.9 ha in total; one of them is in the top priority tier. The restoration deposit for quarries (Decree 08/2022) would make the operator pay to restore the cleared site; before raising it, confirm that the quarry holds a licence, so a deposit and a remediation plan exist; and that the deposit is large enough to pay for restoring karst forest. A conservation-area designation like Kim Bang's would put the forest under a conservation management board; before raising it, confirm that the provincial People's Committee is willing to designate and that conservation organisations sustain the case over several years. India's fixed no-mining buffer around protected areas would ban mining within a set distance of the protected area, but it needs groundwork first: the condition "the patch is within a defined buffer of a protected-area boundary" is not met here.

sites.summary: Van Long - Dong Tam has 33 suspected quarry patches, 55.0 ha in total; the highest-ranked is in the middle priority tier. Of these, 3 lie inside a protected area (Nature Reserve), 10 in a protected-area buffer zone and 20 outside any protected area, and the options differ between them. For the 3 patches inside a protected area (Nature Reserve): Van Long's community-backed reserve management is already in place here, so the question is whether it is working: ask the reserve's management board whether it knew of the clearing and what enforcement followed. The Minerals Law's ban on mining in special-use and protective forest would make quarrying here a breach of an existing prohibition; before raising it, confirm that the province's land records classify this land as special-use or protective forest. For the 10 patches in a protected-area buffer zone: Van Long's community-backed reserve management covers these patches too. The restoration deposit for quarries (Decree 08/2022) would make the operator pay to restore the cleared site; before raising it, confirm that the quarry holds a licence, so a deposit and a remediation plan exist; and that the deposit is large enough to pay for restoring karst forest. For the 20 patches outside any protected area: The restoration deposit for quarries (Decree 08/2022) applies to these patches too, on the same conditions. A conservation-area designation like Kim Bang's would put the forest under a conservation management board; before raising it, confirm that the provincial People's Committee is willing to designate and that conservation organisations sustain the case over several years.
